statement: Two fresh private virtual instances passed exact synthetic LED and named-read roundtrips: brightness, override and RGBW intent were retained independently; repeated 63-byte replies were freshly padded; malformed requests were rejected atomically; and 77 requests and replies matched in each cycle, with zero write failures and complete owned removal. Invalid protocol replies submitted -22 internally; the Linux UHID raw client saw errno 5 for nonzero errors, as kernel source specifies. This evidence is bounded to the tested candidate and host. Actual optical behavior is established only by separate physical experiments.

applicability.revision: Experimental wired USB-bus UHID candidate; no retail revision claim
applicability.firmware: Synthetic compatibility state; no live firmware claim
applicability.scope: Virtual host protocol/error/lifecycle evidence. No physical colour fidelity, wireless or calibrated optics.
